_about: My review (manual) of the Muse-written policy variants of Phase 4's scenarios that will run (amendment 5: every one, before its run): batch 1's scenarios' drop-F units and clones, and any Phase 4 unit a Phase 3 look draws. valid: the variant's request fits exactly its intended matches (two or more) and refers to one record; natural: a user could say it. Read with kit/show_variants.py --review (drop-F) before any run of these variants.
